blocks.text: LANY. Image: Courtesy of Live Nation Philippines CEBU CITY, Philippines — Further technical assessments and maintenance works are underway at SM Seaside Cebu Arena following the cancellation of American pop-rock band LANY’s sold-out concert due to structural safety concerns. Cebu City Mayor Nestor Archival on Friday, Nov. 13, confirmed that the concert was called off as a precautionary measure following the safety concern identified during the band’s sound check on Thursday, Nov. 12.
